sample.question_description: Find the first blocked move in a command sequence.
sample.question_preview: Using the Skybridge 3D movement rules, which command is the first one that fails? Sequence: right, down, up, down, right, up. Options: [1] move 3 [2] move 6 [3...
sample.question:
Using the Skybridge 3D movement rules, which command is the first one that fails? Sequence: right, down, up, down, right, up.
Options:
[1] move 3
[2] move 6
[3] move 4
[4] move 2
[5] move 5
[6] move 1
[7] no move is blocked
sample.analysis:
Move 1 right: moved (normal height rule).
Move 2 down: moved (normal height rule).
Move 3 up: moved (normal height rule).
Move 4 down: moved (normal height rule).
Move 5 right: blocked (outside the board).
Move 6 up: moved (normal height rule).
The first failing command is move 5. Therefore choose option 5.

state_content.rules: Move between adjacent towers. Climb up at most 1 level normally; ladder edges allow climbing up 2 levels. Descending is always allowed.
